model.name: EMOD malaria (IDM), via emodpy-malaria from EMOD-Hub

setting.label: Southern-Nigeria-like, uncalibrated
setting.description: One simulated setting, not a real state: year-round transmission (An. gambiae and An. funestus) with a long-rains peak from about April to October. Background case management (50% of clinical cases, 70% of severe) and bed nets (50% coverage) are the same in every schedule.
setting.outcome: Clinical malaria cases in children 3-24 months over the 2 intervention years
setting.baseline_note: No-PMC cases over 2 years. The 2-seed run counted 1,956; the 6-seed run's reported costs reproduce at about 1,960.

default_costs.source: Connect PMC costing: $0.80 per verified visit, a 20% platform fee, 95% of visits giving a dose

schedules.label: No PMC
schedules.detail: Background case management and nets only. The comparison point.

schedules.label: At vaccine visits (EPI-linked), 25% coverage
schedules.detail: SP given at the 10-week, 14-week, 9-month and 15-month vaccine contacts, reaching 25% of children: the range reported for Osun's EPI-linked PMC.

schedules.label: Connect quarterly, 3-24 months
schedules.detail: A Connect worker visits every 91 days and gives SP to every child aged 3-24 months, 85% coverage.

schedules.label: Connect every 2 months, 3-24 months
schedules.detail: A Connect visit every 61 days, 3-24 months, 85% coverage.

schedules.label: Connect monthly through the high season, 3-24 months
schedules.detail: Six monthly Connect rounds a year, starting about 1 April with the long rains, 3-24 months, 85% coverage.

schedules.label: Connect quarterly, 12-24 months only
schedules.detail: Quarterly Connect rounds restricted to the second year of life, 85% coverage.

references.label: Malaria Journal 2023: modelling PMC in Nigeria with EMOD (IDM, Northwestern, Malaria Consortium, NMEP)
